environment.source: GitHub connector reads pinned to base commit; reused frontend dependencies; only missing PDF/pg type dependencies installed in an isolated temporary prefix

scope: Preserve matching checklist IDs, text and empty template provenance on same-document refresh
Archive a still-valid stale preparation without generating a new snapshot; invalidated source and stale checklist edits stay blocked
Display undated active concerns separately from period events in report body and the same PDF snapshot
Reject new/restored duplicate active family reports for the same child and exact period under the workspace UPDATE lock; preserve different periods and original receipts
Render fixed CJK coverage as complete sentences without clipping

checks.note: Includes parent wrapper; 6 source/store/API scenarios. Serialized fake Pool tests lock ordering and application decisions, not real PostgreSQL concurrency. PDF route renderer is stubbed for source-revalidation testing.
Deterministic production hook and shallow renderer plus existing preparation regression; no browser.
Focused rerun after final PDF formatting edit.

Locally the equivalent scoped config mapped pg and @react-pdf/renderer to an isolated dependency prefix, because the reusable node_modules only contained frontend dependencies. The committed config uses regular package resolution after the repository dependency install. Initial missing-package and NodeNext directory-path failures are retained; no product types were weakened.

checks.command: HOME=<temporary-home> EXPO_NO_TELEMETRY=1 EXPO_OFFLINE=1 EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL=/api npm run build:web --workspace frontend -- --output-dir dist-document-integrity

checks.note: Real react-pdf renderer and repository-pinned WenKaiTC font; Poppler verifies all 135 CJK coverage characters, every sentence, A4 text bounds and immutable snapshot. Final PNG visually inspected. Fixed coverage only; arbitrary unspaced source-body layout is not redesigned.

retainedFailures.initial: 21/24 passed; 3 layout cases failed before reaching assertions because workspace.actions.refresh was absent
retainedFailures.baseline: Exact pinned master renderer with the same old fixture produced the same 3 failures; this is a focused module comparison, not a pristine full master checkout
retainedFailures.fix: Added only actions.refresh() mock; no assertions changed; all 5 layout cases then passed

retainedFailures.details: Frontend export first failed creating the unavailable default HOME/.expo; a temporary writable HOME with offline/no-telemetry export passed. npm initially lacked a writable default cache; installed declared missing dependencies in an isolated prefix with a temporary cache.

Baseline renderer lost complete coverage sentences in actual rendered PDF extraction; the same long-CJK regression passed after sentence formatting. Baseline repeated with pinned React 19.2.3 and failed identically.

notRun: real PostgreSQL or live DB mutations

pdfImageReview.scope: Coverage-only regression acceptance; not a full PDF text/completeness pass
pdfImageReview.result: Final pinned React 19.2.3 PDF was re-rendered and its image inspected. All coverage sentences are visible without clipping or overlap.

knownLimitations: Footer text is missing from both the baseline and fixed PDF extraction/image. This separate issue is not changed or accepted here.
Arbitrary unspaced source-body typesetting and full-PDF text completeness are outside this coverage-only fix.

integration.method: Three-way local merge of docs/API.md; no other proposed path overlaps PR #102. All 11 non-overlapping PR #102 files materialized and verified by their Git blob SHA.
integration.limits: No additional broad test suite or export; no publication retry, merge, deployment, model or database call.
